title: Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developing generalizable, data-efficient machine learning (ML) models for advanced manufacturing remains challenging because experimental datasets are limited and process-property relationships vary across materials and operating conditions. In laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), melt pool width, depth, and melting mode (conduction, transition, or keyhole) govern process stability and defect formation. Conventional ML models typically use dimensional process parameters, which represent laser-material interactions only implicitly and may limit cross-material transfer. This study evaluates whether two physics-informed dimensionless features, normalized enthalpy and Peclet number, combining laser processing conditions with material thermophysical properties, improve melt pool prediction over raw process parameters. translated_title: 基于物理信息特征表示与预训练表格基础模型的泛化熔池几何预测
translated_abstract: 为先进制造开发可泛化、数据高效的机器学习（ML）模型仍然具有挑战性，原因在于实验数据集有限，且工艺-性能关系会随材料与运行条件而变化。在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中，熔池宽度、深度以及熔化模式（导热模式、过渡模式或锁孔模式）决定了工艺稳定性与缺陷形成。传统ML模型通常使用有量纲的工艺参数，这些参数只能隐式地表示激光-材料相互作用，可能限制跨材料迁移能力。本研究评估了两个物理信息驱动的无量纲特征——归一化焓与佩克莱数（Peclet number），它们将激光加工条件与材料热物理性能相结合——相比原始工艺参数能否改善熔池预测。我们系统性地对七个模型进行了基准测试：四种经典ML方法（高斯过程、支持向量机、随机森林和X……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出用归一化焓和佩克莱数两个物理信息无量纲特征替代原始工艺参数，并结合预训练表格基础模型进行基准测试，以提升LPBF熔池几何预测的跨材料泛化能力与数据效率。
en_tdlr: This study replaces raw dimensional process parameters with physics-informed dimensionless features (normalized enthalpy and Peclet number) and benchmarks them alongside pretrained tabular foundation models to achieve generalizable, data-efficient melt pool geometry prediction in laser powder bed fusion.
